lore.dimensional_tears.dimensional_tears: A bottle of tears collected from Crying Obsidian. Pour it on a Nether Portal frame to light it; Flint and Steel isn't strong enough. Drinking it returns you to your spawn point.
A bucket of Dimensional Tears, scooped out of a Basin that Crying Obsidian weeps into. Anything that falls into it is sent back to its spawn point.
effect.dimensional_tears.rifting.descrip: When it runs out, you are pulled through to your spawn point, or to wherever your Dimensional Tears were bound. Water washes it away.
